title: Ice Cream Day: Promotions and Flavors Stir Up São Paulo and Rio Branco
seoTitle: Ice Cream Day: Promotions in São Paulo and Rio Branco
subtitle: Ice cream parlors celebrate the date with special offers and new flavors
excerpt: On Tuesday (23), São Paulo and Rio Branco prepare for Ice Cream Day with buy-one-get-one gelato promos, free cones, and exclusive flavors.
author: Daniele Morais
sourceName: VEJA SÃO PAULO, G1, A Gazeta
contentHtml:
On Tuesday (23), São Paulo and Rio Branco prepare for Ice Cream Day with buy-one-get-one gelato promos, free cones, and exclusive flavors. The date, which celebrates the frozen dessert, brings activity to ice cream shops across the country, offering discounts and freebies to attract customers.

São Paulo brings together ice cream shops with unique flavors

  • Albero dei Gelati – three locations in the city. Owned by Fernanda Pamplona, awarded Ice Cream Maker of the Year by COMER & BEBER 2025, the shop features flavors that change according to ingredient availability. Prices start at R$ 21.00 (up to two flavors). Address: Rua dos Pinheiros, 342, Pinheiros.
  • Cangote Sorvetes – opened in 2022, offers vegan options such as guava and siriguela sorbet. Scoops start at R$ 15.00. Addresses: Rua Aureliano Coutinho, 278, Vila Buarque and Avenida São Luís, 187 (Galeria Metrópole).
  • Frida & Mina – in 2026 it competed for the Best Ice Cream Shop award by COMER & BEBER. It offers strawberry ice cream with balsamic vinegar, mango ice cream, and dairy-free cupuaçu sorbet. Scoops start at R$ 20.00. Address: Rua Artur de Azevedo, 1147, Pinheiros.
  • Grama Sorvetes – owned by Ailin Aleixo and Marcelo Furquim, does not use animal products. The "grass" flavor mixes vanilla with spirulina. Scoops start at R$ 23.00 and the stuffed pancake starts at R$ 25.00. Address: Rua Mourato Coelho, 1210, Vila Madalena.
  • Mooi Mooi – run by chef Oscar Bosch, offers "mixed" machine-churned ice creams. The creamy julieta without romeo costs R$ 27.00. Address: Rua dos Pinheiros, 223, Pinheiros.
  • Nice Cream – no indoor seating, but with benches for tasting. Flavors change daily. The chico bento, made with heavy cream, mascarpone cheese, and guava paste, starts at R$ 19.00 in a cup or R$ 21.00 in a cone. Address: Rua Vicente Leporace, 1060, Campo Belo.
  • Pine Co. – run by brothers Daniel and Raphael Lee. It offers about twenty rotating options daily. The shop was a champion for the third time by COMER & BEBER 2026.

Rio Branco announces exclusive promotions

  • Hours 11 AM to 4 PM: one free small cup for the first 100 customers at each location. Branches: Bairro Floresta, Avenida Ceará, and Epaminondas Jácome (not valid at Via Verde Shopping).
  • Hours 2 PM to 10 PM: buy one scoop of ice cream and get one free; applies to regular cones and large waffle cones. For every two scoops, the customer gets a cone.
  • Popsicle promotion: buy one and get another of the same type in any quantity.
  • Starting at 4 PM, Tropicale's first 20 customers get a handcrafted waffle cone with a scoop of ice cream.
  • Cone promotion: the first 300 customers at each location get a free cone; valid for in-store purchases only.
  • 300 ml milkshake: buy one and get another one free; participating flavors: vanilla, chocolate, passion fruit, and brigadeiro.

Other cities also celebrate with promotions

  • In Espírito Santo, Borelli is giving away free cones during the Gelato Free event (2 PM-4 PM), with 300 units per store in Vitória, Vila Velha, Serra, and Linhares.
  • Real Gelateria offers buy-one-get-one-free gelato at two locations (Rua João da Cruz, 151, Praia do Canto, and Shopping Vitória, Av. Américo Buaiz, 200, Enseada do Suá).
  • At Sal & Mel, a 600 ml tub of gelato costs R$ 50 (1 PM-9:30 PM) in Itapuã, Vila Velha.
  • Le Gustto Gelateria is creating a gelato tasting board for R$ 49.90 in Pedra Azul.
  • Cremino Gelato & Café is handing out artisanal cinnamon cookies as a giveaway in Praia do Canto.
  • Barutti offers a small cup for R$ 12 (regular version R$ 22) across multiple Greater Vitória locations.
  • Shopping Vitória is promoting the I Love Gelato circuit, featuring combos for R$ 22.90, including options with gelato, brownies, cookies, and coffee.

What's trending now?

Ice Cream Day promotions, which include buy-one-get-one ice cream, free cones, and self-service discounts, have boosted searches and orders on delivery platforms such as iFood. In 2026, Acre recorded a 16% growth in ice cream orders at restaurants between January and August, and Rio Branco saw a 12% increase. The most ordered flavors in the country were açai, chocolate, Neapolitan, strawberry, and chocolate chip (flocos), with notable highlights for dulce de leche (>51% growth), pistachio (41%), and coconut (24%).

With information from VEJA SÃO PAULO, G1, A Gazeta.
